description: This file defines the DirectorySearch utility class in a Java project, providing methods for locating repository roots, module roots, source directories, exclude directories, and template directories within an Android development environment.

classes.name: DirectorySearch
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for directory and project structure searches in an Android development environment.

methods.name: getRepoRoot
methods.description: Returns the previously initialized repository root directory.

methods.name: findAndInitRepoRoot
methods.description: Finds and initializes the repository root directory starting from a given file.

methods.name: findModuleRoot
methods.description: Searches up the directory hierarchy to find the module root containing an Android.mk file.

methods.name: findSourceDirs
methods.description: Recursively searches for source directories based on common directory names like 'src' or 'java'.

methods.name: findExcludeDirs
methods.description: Finds directories under 'res' that match exclude patterns, such as language-specific folders.

methods.name: findTemplateDir
methods.description: Locates the template directory, supporting various runtime contexts including IDE and command line.
